text: The Board of Directors of TO Live, at its meeting of September 29, 2022 considered Item CT35.11 and referred the item to a special meeting of the TO Live - Human Resources and Stakeholder Relations Committee, to be called by the Committee Chair before November 7, 2022 for review, discussion and to provide feedback to the City Manager's Office and the consultants.
The TO Live - Human Resources and Stakeholder Relations Committee received the item for information.
